story.title: Industry Readiness Graduate Program (IRGP)
story.description: A focused, hands-on program that helps early-career talent build practical skills, professional confidence, and workplace readiness.
story.modalOverview: The Industry Readiness Graduate Program (IRGP) was developed by Lead Nation Academy as an immersive, industry-guided transition bridge for ambitious university graduates and early-career talent in Bangladesh. Over an intensive multi-week cohort curriculum, participants engaged in real-world business challenges, executive mentorship dialogues, and rigorous professional communication training designed to replicate corporate boardroom expectations.
objectives: Bridge the gap between academic foundation and modern enterprise workplace readiness
Develop high-impact analytical problem-solving and structured business communication skills
Build corporate confidence through direct mentor feedback from executive leaders
Foster team collaboration on live business case simulations and strategic presentations

activities.title: Skill Development Workshops
activities.description: Intensive hands-on masterclasses covering workplace productivity tools, financial literacy, structured business writing, and executive presence.

activities.title: Collaborative Team Projects
activities.description: Small cohort syndicates tackling enterprise business case studies, developing strategy decks, and presenting findings under simulated deadlines.

activities.title: Executive Mentorship Dialogues
activities.description: One-on-one advisory roundtables with senior corporate leaders sharing organizational navigation insights and career roadmaps.

activities.title: Capstone & Program Milestone
activities.description: Final project presentations evaluated by industry juries, culminating in formal cohort completion and verified graduation credentials.
